label: Suppress people

headings.className: section-header-label section-header-label--rule block! border-b pb-3 text-c-1 responses-title--tree mt-3 mb-0 block! leading-[1.45] font-medium

paragraphs: Store a list of people to suppress — the same lists the Suppress list page in the app shows, so a list pushed from your CRM sits next to the CSVs your team uploaded and behaves identically. The suppress list is organization-wide: it applies to every AutoGTM campaign, running or not. Every email is checked against it right before it goes out, so an address added here stops a sequence that is already mid-flight, not just future ones. Matching is exact: a person by their email address (case-insensitive, but jane+crm@acme.com and jane@acme.com are two different entries), a company by its domain (the lead's company domain or the domain of its email address — acme.com does not cover eu.acme.com, list each domain you use). One call = one list, exactly like uploading one CSV: a list name that is already taken gets a (2) suffix rather than merging, and lists are independent — the same person on two lists is suppressed until both are gone. Delete a list you no longer want. Each person needs at least one identifier: an email, a LinkedIn URL, or a full name; a row left without a usable one (including a malformed address) comes back in skipped instead of failing the whole batch. Outreach stops on the email — the name and LinkedIn fields are stored but not actively used today; they are kept because a suppressed person is more than their email address, and the day outreach runs somewhere other than email (LinkedIn and the like) those are the fields that will match. To suppress everyone at a company use the companies endpoint.
